title: Telephone Call Routing Guide
brief: A front-desk telephone routing guide for Juniper Family Clinic, drafted from its staff directory and call-handling procedures.

slip.document:
# Telephone Call Routing Guide
Juniper Family Clinic | Front desk | Effective 03/16/2026

## Staff routing
| Staff member | Role | Extension |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dmitri Sandoval | Scheduling coordinator | 203 |
| Colleen Sato | Referral and insurance specialist | 214 |
| Grace Kowalczyk | Clinical triage nurse | 228 |

## Answering and routing
- Answer with: "Juniper Family Clinic, this is the front desk. How may I direct your call?"
- Ask for the caller's name, callback number, and a brief reason for calling before transferring. Confirm the intended staff member and announce the caller before completing a warm transfer.
- Route appointment requests and cancellations to Dmitri Sandoval at extension 203. Route referral status and insurance authorization questions to Colleen Sato at extension 214.
- Route prescription questions and non-emergency clinical concerns to Grace Kowalczyk at extension 228. Do not interpret symptoms, provide medical advice, or promise a clinical callback time.
- Direct all insurance authorization questions to Grace Kowalczyk at extension 228.
- If the staff member does not answer, take a message with the caller's name, callback number, reason for calling, and the time received. Send it through the clinic's secure internal message system; do not leave clinical details on a shared voicemail.

## Urgent calls
- For severe breathing difficulty, keep the caller on the line and page the triage nurse at extension 228.
- For a caller explicitly reporting immediate danger, instruct the caller to call 911. Do not transfer an emergency call as a substitute for emergency services.

## Closing the call
- Repeat the requested action and the staff member or team receiving the message. Thank the caller and document the call in the telephone log before moving to the next call.

errors.quote: Direct all insurance authorization questions to Grace Kowalczyk
errors.explanation: The staff directory identifies Colleen Sato as the referral and insurance specialist, and the earlier routing instruction assigns authorization questions to Colleen. This line contradicts both pieces of information.
errors.fix: Direct all insurance authorization questions to Colleen Sato

errors.quote: For severe breathing difficulty, keep the caller on the line and page the triage nurse at extension 228.
errors.explanation: This instruction omits telling the caller to contact emergency services for severe breathing difficulty. Paging the clinic nurse alone could delay urgent care.
errors.fix: For severe breathing difficulty, instruct the caller to call 911 immediately; do not delay for a clinic transfer or page.
